description: Integrate the 4 standalone wallet parsers (Ledger, Trezor, Sparrow, Coldcard) into the CLI import system, providing wallet users with consistent import semantics
principles: Reuse existing infrastructure - leverage BaseImporter and registry pattern
Consistent output format - same (colnames, transactions) tuple
Mechanical refactoring - convert functions to classes
Wallet-specific semantics - require --wallet-name for deposits, optional --withdraw-to for withdrawals
Clean removal - delete orphaned wallet_imports.py after migration
